newsitem.title: UK: Carpetright chief sells shrs at 569.25/shr.
newsitem.headline: Carpetright chief sells shrs at 569.25/shr.

text.p: Carpetright Plc said on Thursday that its chairman and chief executive Lord Harris had sold four million shares at a price of 569.25 pence per share.
The shares have been placed with institutional and other investors by SBC Wrburg.
Harris now owns a beneficial interest in 12,075,970 shares representing 15.2 percent of Carpetrights's ordinary share capital.
He also gave an undertaking that he would sell no more shares for at least two years.
Carpetright was marked 4 1/2 pence down at 585 pence on Thursday.
